compose.scope: The three private-leaf deployment checks certify catalog, frozen publication identity and restored bindings. They do not prove an offline parent model naturally selects delegation; the real SDK delegation path is exercised by PrivateAgentDelegationIT.

schema.privacy_mapping: All historical attempts use the frozen target identity and the same length-prefixed UTF-8 scope hash as Java. SQL metadata helpers locate privacy copies and flag residuals; they do not certify authorization, manifest digests or runtime compatibility.

execution_contract.target: same-owner private Agent with an explicit non-null v3 execution plan and empty requested capabilities, actual capabilities and scopes
execution_contract.binding: agent-leaf/1 freezes target Agent ID and immutable release hash; execution never substitutes the current deployment pointer
execution_contract.input: Only explicit message; no implicit parent profile, long memory, work context, history or tool-result injection
execution_contract.models: Independent target primary/fallback adapters; strict RuntimeArtifacts compatibility; each physical call reserves child and parent counters
execution_contract.budget_scope: The target release maximum and the shared parent Turn budget also apply; changing attempts does not reset the persistent child count.
execution_contract.parent_support: artifact:read and function:read_artifact_range support governed offloading of large child results; these tools are not installed in the leaf.
execution_contract.lifecycle: Existing parent Claim, Command, fence, cancellation and privacy/grant gates; no child queue, lease, heartbeat or scheduler.

recovery_limits.same_attempt: A valid current attempt can finish a saved SDK final checkpoint whose child business result was not committed, without another model request even if the four-call budget is exhausted.
recovery_limits.cross_attempt: Only committed child business results replay across attempts. Old SDK state is not copied or resumed to fill a missing child receipt.
recovery_limits.root_authority: A child completion does not clear root blocked/unconfirmed_execution. RecoverTaskService still requires a sealed root attempt receipt.

not_certified: a single complete successful Maven verify
full-permission or recursive private Agent delegation
offline parent natural-language selection of delegation by Compose
